parts:
good evening everyone,
I am running a mediation model in which the predictor is dichotomous, while the dependent and mediator are continuous (they are factorial scores). 
How do I calculate the effects of the predictor on the other variables?
I think I should use the Std.lv index to describe "a" and "c" effects, this should allow the correct comparison with effect b.
thanks in advance, have a good evening
